statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail risk remains in the low band on an orderly two-sided overnight path, while Stress is elevated ahead of a dense scheduled event stack.
recommendation: Conditions are consistent with normal mean-reverting structure at present. The scheduled 12:30 UTC data block and the after-close NVIDIA release are the two evidence-based checkpoints where the mapped state may change; the assessment is refreshed hourly.
headline: Orderly two-sided overnight NQ path keeps Tail low into a heavy Wednesday event stack
body: NQ futures trade near 29,212, about -0.2%, in the middle of a two-sided 29,096-29,310 overnight band after the Nasdaq-100 cash close at 29,209 (+0.64%). VIX is 15.71 in a narrow 15.64-15.73 range, WTI is near $80 after a roughly 2.8% decline on Iran-Oman Strait of Hormuz corridor diplomacy, and Treasury yields are steady with the 2Y at 4.24% and the 10Y at 4.70% on the latest H.15. There is no observed directional efficiency, no session-extreme holding and no shallow-pullback structure, so Tail stays in the low band. Stress is elevated because the scheduled stack is dense: Core PCE, the Q2 GDP second estimate, durable goods and personal income all print at 12:30 UTC, roughly two hours before the 13:30 UTC cash open, and NVIDIA reports after the 20:00 UTC close with consensus near $2.09 EPS on about $92B revenue. Recent FOMC minutes indicated broader support for a rate hike than the formal 9-3 vote implied, which raises the policy sensitivity of the inflation print two days before the Warsh Jackson Hole keynote. Delayed cross-asset context shows mixed megacap breadth, four of eight higher last session, and a mildly constructive semiconductor tone; none of it establishes live one-way NQ structure. Confidence is high on current verified levels, yields, oil, volatility and calendar coverage.

lookbackSummary: The previous 24 published hours moved from a watch-band Tuesday European session, Tail 20-21 with a trend-up mode, into a steadily calmer regime: Tail fell through the US cash session to 9-12 and has held at 11 across the entire overnight window with a normal dominant mode. Stress drifted up from the mid-40s to 54 as the Wednesday event stack approached, and Confidence stayed at 87-88 throughout, so the mapped policy state has been EA_ON continuously since 14:00 UTC on 25 August.
outlookSummary: The horizon is shaped by two scheduled binary checkpoints rather than by any observed trend. Conditional Tail rises into the watch band around the 12:30 UTC data block and the 13:30 UTC cash open, eases through the midday and early afternoon, then peaks at the top of the watch band for the 20:00-22:00 UTC NVIDIA release and guidance call, where a delayed second leg is the structural concern. From late evening onward, conditional Tail decays back into the low band as the binary events resolve and Asian then European hours favour range formation, with the Warsh Jackson Hole keynote on Friday at 14:00 UTC as the next major checkpoint beyond this horizon.
